beforeExecutionPhaseCaveat: Empty-base SS commonly auto-enters routine execution. A helper called pending can intercept an already-executing lifecycle with no sample. Capture actual entry before callback; do not relabel it a presented player decision or claim completed action facts existed before execution.
originAndSamplerCaveats: Existing Match/PA/physical raw identity copies can support a future typed bundle; fixed-slot projection is not currently pinned.
Original canonical throw namespaces include selected route; receiver sampler B must not reuse them as physical slot or incorporate retry/outcome.
SS original sample is generated only once by original owner; no second receiver roll, preload, callback or stage simulation is authorized.
v1 saved coarse timing is reusable as v1 evidence, not automatically a v2 upstream-launch CRT timestamp; unknown numeric arrival stays unavailable.
atBase=true, roster assignment and available NPC identity are distinct from measured starting context/readiness/contact.

timingBoundaryAnalysis.legacyOrigin: The v1 ball scalar and runner relativeArrival share the existing coarse race convention. Neither establishes an observed contact-to-upstream-launch offset. The named upstream-launch zero of the isolated S8 contract is a different proposed origin, not a currently saved Production timestamp.
timingBoundaryAnalysis.quantizationVersusOrigin: A versioned deterministic conversion such as scalar*1000 can only be a unit-quantization projection B. It cannot establish a new origin. To preserve the same race under a new upstream-launch origin, both BALL and RUNNER must subtract the same authoritative launch offset before applying the same versioned quantization policy; that offset/source is currently C.
timingBoundaryAnalysis.legacyTie: v1 classify uses margin>0.5 / margin<-0.5 for clearly-ahead labels and otherwise closePlay. Actual deriveSettlement requires timingMargin>0, so exact tie does not establish a defensive out; tag also requires tagCompletion<runner.relativeArrival. A closePlay label alone is not an out.
timingBoundaryAnalysis.v2Tie: The isolated S8 candidate contract separately requires runnerArrival-contestCompletion>0 and emits no candidate for exact tie. Preserving v1 timing does not itself admit a v2 candidate or prove the required possession/contact stage.
timingBoundaryAnalysis.unknown: Hold saves null arrival/completion. Offline or unavailable receive may retain runnerArrival but no numeric ball arrival, only a quality object and noContest. These states remain unavailable/insufficient rather than zero-valued time.
timingBoundaryAnalysis.physicalTouch: v1 receiverCompletion.relativeCompletion is ballTime+receiveDelay; v1 retirement uses the constant atBase=true for force/base contests. It is not an independently observed physical base touch. The later terminal action status is derived from retirement and does not supply a physical touch timestamp.
futureMinimum: Original timing owner must define explicit source, origin version, CRT unit/quantization version, and supported conversion semantics.
An authoritative common launch offset or independently sourced common-origin ball and runner times must precede the proposed upstream-launch binding.
Positioning, Secure possession and contact completion need independent same-origin sources; old default delays do not certify them.
The existing strict v1 resolveTiming equality must remain; a future owner-approved version seam is required rather than adding v2 delay to a v1 object.
